daredevil_born_again_season3_end.headline: Stephen Amell Instagram Tease Sparks Arrow Return Rumors
daredevil_born_again_season3_end.summary: Stephen Amell posted a cryptic Instagram video featuring a Green Arrow wanted poster, prompting fan speculation about his possible return to the role.
highlights: Amell’s Instagram video shows him eyeing a hand‑drawn Green Arrow wanted poster
His caption reads “Just when I think I’m out”, hinting at a potential comeback
The post has generated widespread fan discussion about a possible cameo or new DC project
daredevil_born_again_season3_end.why_it_matters: A return of Amell would link the beloved Arrowverse to the new DCU, impacting fan expectations for future crossovers.

jojo_steel_ball_run_trailer_2026.headline: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run
jojo_steel_ball_run_trailer_2026.summary: Netflix released a special recap trailer ahead of the weekly release of new Steel Ball Run episodes starting September 25, 2026.
highlights: The recap trailer highlights key scenes from Stage 1 to prep fans for Stages 2 and 3
The upcoming arc will consist of 11 weekly episodes covering the second and third stages of the race
The series returns to Netflix with a weekly schedule after fan backlash over the initial special episode
jojo_steel_ball_run_trailer_2026.why_it_matters: The trailer signals the continuation of a long‑awaited adaptation, re‑engaging the franchise’s global fanbase.

sequel_s_biggest_horror_movie_just_got_a.headline: Expelled from Paradise: Resonance of the Heart
sequel_s_biggest_horror_movie_just_got_a.summary: The sequel to the 2014 anime film Expelled from Paradise will debut in Japanese cinemas on November 13, 2026.
highlights: A new teaser trailer and visual have been released
Voice actor Rie Kugimiya returns as Angela Balzac
Sumire Morihoshi joins the cast as new character Penem
The film reunites director Seiji Mizushima and writer Gen Urobuchi
sequel_s_biggest_horror_movie_just_got_a.why_it_matters: It continues the acclaimed sci‑fi franchise with returning talent and a fresh storyline for fans.

ani_one_asia_licenses_iceblade_sorcerer_.headline: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Season 2
ani_one_asia_licenses_iceblade_sorcerer_.summary: Ani‑One Asia has licensed the second season of The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World, set to stream across Southeast Asia in October.
highlights: Zero‑G takes over animation from Cloud Hearts for the new season
Returning director Masahiro Takata also serves as scriptwriter and sound director
New character designer Mariko Kawamoto replaces Makoto Shimojima
Opening theme "Diamond Dust" performed by Sizuk
ani_one_asia_licenses_iceblade_sorcerer_.why_it_matters: The change in animation studio and staff signals a fresh visual direction for a popular light‑novel adaptation.

grand_blue_4th_season_production.headline: Foodies
grand_blue_4th_season_production.summary: Kodansha’s Comic Days platform posted the final chapter of Tadashi Agi and Jun Nakanishi’s Foodies manga on September 16, 2026, ending the series.
highlights: The final chapter was released on Comic Days on September 16, 2026
The chapter will become free to read on September 30, 2026
Foodies launched on Comic Days in August 2025 and has released four compiled volumes, the latest on July 17, 2026
grand_blue_4th_season_production.why_it_matters: The conclusion wraps up a popular gourmet‑themed series by prolific writer Tadashi Agi, offering fans closure and free access to the finale.

batman_knightfall_part2_trailer.headline: The Avengers – Deleted Scene “Steve Rogers: A Man Out of Time”
batman_knightfall_part2_trailer.summary: A three‑minute deleted scene from The Avengers, revealed on the 2012 Blu‑ray release, provides the original setup for Steve’s emotional arc that was later re‑created in Captain America: The Winter Soldier.
highlights: The scene shows Steve Rogers reviewing deceased teammates’ files, including a live‑address for Peggy Carter
It was included on the September 2012 Blu‑ray as part of fifteen minutes of deleted material
The payoff of the scene appears in the theatrical cut via the waitress Beth, but the setup was missing until the later film
Director Joss Whedman confirmed he regretted cutting the scene, calling it essential character work
batman_knightfall_part2_trailer.why_it_matters: The deleted scene illustrates how the MCU had to rebuild a key emotional moment in a later movie, highlighting the importance of cut footage in shaping the franchise’s storytelling.

dc_robins_casting_movie.headline: Dynamic Duo
dc_robins_casting_movie.summary: An upcoming DC animated film will explore the origins of Dick Grayson and Jason Todd, with reported voice casting for both characters.
highlights: Mason Thames is reported to voice Dick Grayson
Logan Kim is reported to voice Jason Todd
The film is directed by Arthur Mintz and uses Swaybox’s TiNK facial animation system
Dynamic Duo is slated for a theatrical release on June 30, 2028
dc_robins_casting_movie.why_it_matters: It marks a major addition to the DC Elseworlds animated lineup, focusing on the iconic Robins and their divergent paths.

dcu_clayface_trailer_2026_09_24.headline: Clayface (2026)
highlights: The trailer reveals graphic scenes of Matt Hagen’s disfigurement and revenge-driven transformation
Clayface will be the DCU’s inaugural R‑rated movie, marking a darker tonal shift for the franchise
The film is scheduled to open in theaters on Oct. 23, 2026
dcu_clayface_trailer_2026_09_24.why_it_matters: It introduces the DCU’s first R‑rated horror entry, expanding the franchise’s genre range

spider_man_1000_preview.headline: Amazing Spider-Man #1000
spider_man_1000_preview.summary: Marvel’s landmark Amazing Spider-Man #1000, featuring Noah Hawley’s debut story about an older Peter Parker, hits comic stores on September 30, 2026.

The issue includes a new villain Ravage and contributions from creators like Joe Kelly, Frank Miller, Dan Slott, and Brian Michael Bendis
Amazing Spider-Man #1000 will showcase multiple anniversary stories and a special cover by Pepe Larraz and John Romita Jr.
spider_man_1000_preview.why_it_matters: The issue celebrates Spider-Man’s 1,000th issue, marking a historic milestone and introducing fresh creative talent to the character’s legacy.

snowball_earth_manga_heads_final_arc_exc.headline: Snowball Earth
snowball_earth_manga_heads_final_arc_exc.summary: Yuhiro Tsujitsugu announced that the Snowball Earth manga has surpassed 1 million copies and is entering its final arc.
highlights: Manga exceeded 1 million copies in circulation per the author’s X announcement
The series will begin its final arc after the 12th volume releases on September 30, 2026
Viz Media will release the English 10th volume on December 15, 2026
The anime adaptation by Studio KAI premiered on April 3, 2026 and a second season is confirmed
snowball_earth_manga_heads_final_arc_exc.why_it_matters: Reaching the million‑copy milestone highlights the series’ strong fanbase and signals a climactic conclusion for the story.

shin_oishinbo_reveals_main_staff_major_t.headline: Shin Oishinbo
shin_oishinbo_reveals_main_staff_major_t.summary: The upcoming TV anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo, has revealed its main cast and key staff.

The anime will be produced by Shin‑Ei Animation and animated by SynergySP and Vega Entertainment
It is scheduled to premiere in 2027
shin_oishinbo_reveals_main_staff_major_t.why_it_matters: It marks the first new TV anime for the long‑running Oishinbo franchise since its original 1992 series, re‑introducing the classic culinary manga to a new generation.

magical_sisters_lulutto_lilly_anime_main.headline: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly
magical_sisters_lulutto_lilly_anime_main.summary: Bandai Namco Filmworks released the main trailer for the second cour of the magical‑girl anime, confirming its October 4 debut.

magical_sisters_lulutto_lilly_anime_main.why_it_matters: The trailer reveals fresh music and cast additions, building anticipation for the continuation of a franchise celebrating its 40‑year anniversary.

aoki_densh_welsh_shedar_anime_s_main_rev.headline: Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar
aoki_densh_welsh_shedar_anime_s_main_rev.summary: The main trailer for the original Ankama fantasy anime reveals additional cast, theme song artists, and confirms an October 2 premiere on Tokyo MX.

Theme songs performed by Hironobu Kageyama, Masami Okui, and KUKO

aoki_densh_welsh_shedar_anime_s_main_rev.why_it_matters: It marks Ankama’s first original TV anime, expanding the French studio’s franchise into the Japanese broadcast market.

phantom_busters_tv_anime_manga_anime_ada.headline: Phantom Busters

phantom_busters_tv_anime_manga_anime_ada.why_it_matters: The adaptation brings a popular, high‑circulation manga to a broader TV audience, expanding its international fanbase.

comicbook.com/movies/news/the-dcus-final.headline: Why Clayface Marks a Dark Turn for the DCU

avengers_doomsday_early_release_change.headline: Adventure Time: Side Quests Season 2 Trailer Released
avengers_doomsday_early_release_change.summary: A new trailer reveals Season 2 of Adventure Time: Side Quests, returning Finn and Jake with deep‑cut characters and a fresh art style.

The series explores younger versions of Finn and Jake with a painting‑like visual style
avengers_doomsday_early_release_change.why_it_matters: It expands the Adventure Time universe with fresh storytelling and visual direction, appealing to both longtime fans and new viewers.

norimitsu_kaih_kurageso_s_akarui_mirai_m.headline: Akarui Mirai
norimitsu_kaih_kurageso_s_akarui_mirai_m.summary: Norimitsu Kaihō and Kurageso’s Akarui Mirai manga will conclude with its next chapter in the October 23 issue of Manga Time Kirara Forward.
highlights: The series began serialization in August 2025 in Houbunsha’s Manga Time Kirara Forward

The final chapter is scheduled for the October 23, 2026 issue
Creator Norimitsu Kaihō is known for School-Live! and other notable works
norimitsu_kaih_kurageso_s_akarui_mirai_m.why_it_matters: The ending marks the close of a short‑run series by a creator famed for influential survival‑genre manga, offering fans a definitive conclusion.

disney_confirms_an_earlier_avengers_doom.headline: Avengers: Doomsday
disney_confirms_an_earlier_avengers_doom.summary: Disney has moved the UK theatrical release of Avengers: Doomsday up two days to December 16, 2026, while the worldwide release remains December 18, 2026.
highlights: The earlier date applies only to theatergoers in the United Kingdom

disney_confirms_an_earlier_avengers_doom.why_it_matters: A staggered release risks spoiling the film for global audiences and may fuel fan backlash over perceived unfairness.

gachiakuta_drops_new_look_coolest_ahead_.headline: Gachiakuta Season 2 First‑Look Trailer Released
gachiakuta_drops_new_look_coolest_ahead_.summary: A first‑look trailer for Gachiakuta Season 2 was unveiled, confirming the upcoming anime sequel.
highlights: The trailer premiered at Anime Expo 2026 and the 25th Comic Exhibition in Taipei

The original series ran 24 episodes from July to December 2025, produced by Studio Bones
gachiakuta_drops_new_look_coolest_ahead_.why_it_matters: Season 2 continues the acclaimed shonen series that dominated 2025, raising expectations for its next narrative arc.

that_we_draw_anime_reveals_first_january.headline: Now That We Draw
that_we_draw_anime_reveals_first_january.summary: The romantic‑comedy manga Now That We Draw received its first teaser trailer and a January 2027 premiere date.
highlights: First teaser trailer unveiled
Director Shunsuke Ishikawa and studio ROLL2 confirmed
Series composition by Deko Akao and character design by Hiromi Nakagawa

that_we_draw_anime_reveals_first_january.why_it_matters: It marks the first animated adaptation of a popular seinen rom‑com manga, expanding its audience ahead of a 2027 debut.

robert_pattinson_batman_crossover_gunn.headline: Boba Fett Standalone Film Cancelled
robert_pattinson_batman_crossover_gunn.summary: A planned Boba Fett movie, initially attached to director Josh Trank and later James Mangold, was abandoned after development stalled at Lucasfilm.
highlights: Josh Trank was reported to direct the Boba Fett film with Simon Kinberg involved
The project was slated for a reveal at Star Wars Celebration 2015 but was pulled
A later attempt with James Mangold also failed to reach production
The character later appeared in The Mandalorian and received a Disney+ series, The Book of Boba Fett
robert_pattinson_batman_crossover_gunn.why_it_matters: The cancellation shows Lucasfilm’s shifting strategy for standalone Star Wars films, redirecting the character to successful streaming series instead.

nycc_skybound_teases_new_comic_book_line.headline: Skybound new comics line (teased)
nycc_skybound_teases_new_comic_book_line.summary: Skybound will announce a new comics line during its NYCC panel "Vision for the Future" on October 9, 2026.

nycc_skybound_teases_new_comic_book_line.why_it_matters: A new Skybound line could reshape the publisher’s portfolio and offer fresh storytelling opportunities for fans of its flagship franchises.

marvel_comics_full_december_solicits_and.headline: Marvel December 2026 Solicits Reveal New Post‑Armageddon Titles
marvel_comics_full_december_solicits_and.summary: Marvel Comics released its full December 2026 solicit list, introducing new series like Maximum X‑Men, Fugitive X‑Force and several Midnight one‑shots.
highlights: Maximum X‑Men #1 launches a new mutant team after the Armageddon event
Fugitive X‑Force #1 starts a five‑issue run with a new leader for the team
Midnight X‑Men, Midnight Fantastic Four and Midnight Spider‑Man continue with issue #3 each
Avengers #2 returns with a demonic invasion storyline featuring Mephisto
marvel_comics_full_december_solicits_and.why_it_matters: The lineup expands Marvel's post‑Armageddon universe and sets up major crossover threads for upcoming events.

crunchyroll_screens_dive_wonderland_film.headline: Dive in Wonderland (Fushigi no Kuni de Alice to)
crunchyroll_screens_dive_wonderland_film.summary: Crunchyroll will screen the anime film Dive in Wonderland in select U.S. theaters on November 16 as part of its Anime Nights program.

Directed by Toshiya Shinohara with a script by Yūko Kakihara, produced by P.A. Works
Crunchyroll will present a one‑day theatrical event on November 16 across the United States
SEKAI NO OWARI performs the theme song "Zukan" for the film
crunchyroll_screens_dive_wonderland_film.why_it_matters: It marks the first U.S. theatrical showcase of this landmark anime adaptation, expanding its international exposure beyond streaming

erica_schultz_gary_erskine_create_murder.headline: Murderbot Diaries: All Systems Red – Graphic Novel
erica_schultz_gary_erskine_create_murder.summary: The first Murderbot graphic novel, adapted by Erica Schultz and Gary Erskine, launches as a Kickstarter exclusive on October 15, 2026.
highlights: Adapted by Erica Schultz (Daredevil, Spawn, X‑Men) and Gary Erskine (Dan Dare, Hellblazer, Punisher, Wolverine)

Kickstarter launch on October 15 with limited collectible editions and variant covers by Tommy Arnold, John Picacio, and Francesca Myman
Retail edition slated for early 2028
erica_schultz_gary_erskine_create_murder.why_it_matters: It expands the award‑winning Murderbot universe into comics, offering fans new canonical content and a chance to support the project directly via Kickstarter.

cinema_is_healing_why_gremlins_has_fans_.headline: Gremlins 3
highlights: The teaser reveals the sequel’s release has been moved from November 19 2027 to October 6 2028.
Gizmo appears as a physical animatronic puppet, echoing the original 1984 design by Chris Walas.
Chris Columbus returns as director and Steven Spielberg is credited as executive producer.
The film will be the first live‑action Gremlins movie since 1990’s Gremlins 2.
cinema_is_healing_why_gremlins_has_fans_.why_it_matters: The use of practical puppetry signals a return to the franchise’s classic aesthetic while the new 2028 date gives fans a concrete timeline.

sekiro_no_defeat_tv_anime_2027.headline: SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT (TV Anime)
sekiro_no_defeat_tv_anime_2027.summary: The eight‑episode SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT TV anime will premiere in January 2027, expanding on the recently released theatrical version.
highlights: The series will run for eight episodes, releasing weekly starting January 2027
It adds new scenes and cuts not present in the theatrical film
Directed by Kenichi Kutsuna with staff including screenwriter Takuya Satou and character designer Takahiro Kishida
Produced by studio Qzil.la and will stream worldwide on Crunchyroll (excluding Japan and several regions)
sekiro_no_defeat_tv_anime_2027.why_it_matters: It offers fans a more complete adaptation of the FromSoftware game, delivering content beyond the limited‑run film.

one_the_best_thrillers_the_2010s_officia.headline: The Girl With The Dragon Tattoo (TV series reboot)
one_the_best_thrillers_the_2010s_officia.summary: Sky is developing a new TV adaptation of Stieg Larsson’s Millennium series with David Oyelowo as Mikael Blomkvist and Viola Prettejohn as Lisbeth Salander.

one_the_best_thrillers_the_2010s_officia.why_it_matters: The diverse casting reimagines a beloved character, potentially reshaping audience perception of the franchise.

the_apothecary_diaries_star_teases_the_b.headline: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
the_apothecary_diaries_star_teases_the_b.summary: The third season of The Apothecary Diaries will debut on October 2, 2026 in a split‑cour format, with the second half slated for April 2027.

Directed by Akinori Fudesaka at OLM with series composition by Norihiko Naganuma
the_apothecary_diaries_star_teases_the_b.why_it_matters: The split‑cour release extends the franchise’s momentum and promises significant story and tonal shifts highlighted by the cast.

chiikawa_anime_temporarily_halt_new_epis.headline: Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast
chiikawa_anime_temporarily_halt_new_epis.summary: The Chiikawa TV anime will temporarily halt regular new episodes and air a revival rebroadcast of 25 influential episodes until December 25, 2026.
highlights: The revival rebroadcast will focus on early episodes and those linked to the recent film Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island
The pause runs from April 2026 through December 25, 2026, after which new episodes are expected to resume
Sentai Filmworks continues to license the series, streaming it on HIDIVE with English subtitles
The series originally premiered in April 2022 and shifted to a twice‑weekly schedule in April 2023
chiikawa_anime_temporarily_halt_new_epis.why_it_matters: The pause gives fans a chance to revisit key episodes while the studio prepares the next season, maintaining audience engagement.

spaceopera_final_chapter_2026.headline: Be Forever Yamato: REBEL3199 Chapter 7: Rainbow Samsara
spaceopera_final_chapter_2026.summary: Bandai Namco Filmworks released the full trailer for the final chapter of the Space Battleship Yamato remake, set to debut in Japanese theaters on October 30, 2026.
highlights: The trailer showcases epic battles on Earth and in space for the series' climactic finale
The seventh chapter concludes the seven‑part, 26‑episode remake that began in July 2024
The film will open in Japan on October 30, 2026, following the June 26 release of Chapter 6
The series holds a 7.6/10 IMDb rating and a 4.8/5 rating on Crunchyroll
spaceopera_final_chapter_2026.why_it_matters: It marks the conclusion of a highly acclaimed revival of a classic mecha franchise, drawing both longtime fans and new audiences.

ignition_press_full_december_solicits_ma.headline: Ignition Press December 2026 Solicits
ignition_press_full_december_solicits_ma.summary: Ignition Press released its full December 2026 solicit list, featuring new and concluding issues across eleven horror, sci‑fi and fantasy titles.

Final issues are slated for Dispatched and Sicko while Prima Apparata reaches its penultimate chapter
Mad Science Division, Minotaur and Rampant Swine add new chaos‑driven horror entries for December
Key creators such as Aaron Campbell, Tim Seeley, Ben Templesmith, Cullen Bunn and Si Spurrier return on multiple titles
ignition_press_full_december_solicits_ma.why_it_matters: The solicit highlights Ignition Press’s commitment to expanding its horror‑centric indie lineup while wrapping up several ongoing series.

sekiro_anime_jan2027.headline: Sekiro: No Defeat
sekiro_anime_jan2027.summary: The Sekiro: No Defeat anime will be re-edited into an eight‑episode TV series that streams on Crunchyroll in January.
highlights: Eight‑episode TV format will reconstruct the theatrical film
Crunchyroll will stream the series worldwide except Japan, China, Korea, Russia, and Belarus
Original game cast reprise their roles, including Daisuke Namikawa as Sekiro
Directed by Kenichi Kutsuna at studio Qzil.la
sekiro_anime_jan2027.why_it_matters: Fans of the award‑winning game can now follow the story in a serialized format, expanding the franchise’s reach.

mission_yozakura_family_s_video_reveals_.headline: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2
mission_yozakura_family_s_video_reveals_.summary: A new promotional video for the second cour of Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 reveals five additional cast members and confirms its October 11 premiere.
highlights: Hōchū Ōtsuka, Miku Itō, Yumiri Hanamori, Sumire Uesaka, and Naomi Shindoh join the cast

Opening theme "Forever Song" is performed by Humbreaders and ending theme "I'm Still Breathing" by KID PHENOMENON
Chief director Mirai Minato returns at studio SILVER LINK
mission_yozakura_family_s_video_reveals_.why_it_matters: The added voice talent expands the series' character roster as the story enters its most pivotal arc.

the_fake_alchemist_anime_s_unveils_staff.headline: The Fake Alchemist
the_fake_alchemist_anime_s_unveils_staff.summary: Kadokawa released a teaser revealing the cast, staff, and Passione as the animation studio for the upcoming TV anime adaptation of The Fake Alchemist manga.
highlights: Yōhei Matsuoka voices Paracelsus and Miyari Nemoto voices Nora
Takeo Takahashi serves as chief director with Hijiri Sanpei as director
Kenta Ihara handles series scripts; Yuka Takashina designs characters; Luke Standridge composes music
Passione is confirmed as the animation studio
the_fake_alchemist_anime_s_unveils_staff.why_it_matters: The reveal confirms a high‑profile production team for a manga that has already sold over one million copies, raising expectations for a major 2026 fall anime season.

mtg_mage_of_zhalfir_dark_horse_2027.headline: Magic: The Gathering: Mage of Zhalfir
mtg_mage_of_zhalfir_dark_horse_2027.summary: Dark Horse Comics will launch the twelve‑issue series Magic: The Gathering: Mage of Zhalfir in January 2027, exploring Teferi Akosa’s Year One at the Tolarian Academy.
highlights: The series is a 12‑issue run debuting on 20 January 2027
Written by Ray Fawkes with Rapha Lobosco and Jão Canola penciling the first four issues
Covers are illustrated by Paris Alleyne and Mateus Manhanini
Lettering is provided by AndWorld Design
mtg_mage_of_zhalfir_dark_horse_2027.why_it_matters: It expands the Magic: The Gathering lore in comics, giving fans a deep look at a major planeswalker’s origins.

penguin_gives_an_english_bookshop_a_gran.headline: Penguin Gives An English Bookshop A Grant To Fund Kids Reading Comics
penguin_gives_an_english_bookshop_a_gran.summary: Penguin Random House UK awarded a grant to The Children’s Bookshelf in Hereford to run a manga and graphic‑novel reading programme for Year 5‑6 pupils.
highlights: Over 40 independent UK bookshops received grants from the £150,000 Children’s Bookshop Grant 2026
The Children’s Bookshelf secured funding for 30 fully‑funded places targeting reluctant, neurodivergent and dyslexic readers

penguin_gives_an_english_bookshop_a_gran.why_it_matters: The initiative uses visual storytelling to engage reluctant readers and supports inclusive literacy development in UK schools.

sheena_and_pigeon_spies_highest_graded_s.headline: Sheena, Queen of the Jungle #2 (Fiction House, 1942)
sheena_and_pigeon_spies_highest_graded_s.summary: A CGC‑graded 9.2 copy of Sheena, Queen of the Jungle #2 is slated for auction at the September 2026 Comic Books Signature Auction.
highlights: The issue features Sheena battling Nazi pigeon spies in the wartime story "Swastika Plague."
Bob Webb’s art blends jungle adventure with WWII intrigue, including leopard cults and vampire vultures.
Only one CGC 9.2 Rockford pedigree copy exists among 20 Universal certifications.

Marvel openly marketed the book as a playful “troll” of DC’s Identity Crisis, but the stunt backfired and sales were underwhelming
marvel_trolled_dc_comics_and_it_will_alw.why_it_matters: The book exemplifies the early‑2000s Marvel‑DC rivalry and shows how meta‑marketing can affect fan reception.

avengers_doomsday_video_release_2026.headline: Avengers: Doomsday
avengers_doomsday_video_release_2026.summary: Marvel released a new promotional video showing Hayley Atwell alongside the ensemble cast for the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday film.
highlights: Hayley Atwell appears for the first time with the Doomsday cast in promotional material
The video features Chris Evans, Anthony Mackie, Danny Ramirez, Simu Liu and others
The film will also include the Fantastic Four and X‑Men casts, with Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom
Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, the film is set for release on December 18, 2026
avengers_doomsday_video_release_2026.why_it_matters: The promo confirms Atwell's return as Peggy Carter and expands the visible scope of the massive multiverse crossover

dc_skydance_roles_2026_10_06.headline: Skydance Corp. Defines DC Studios & DC Comics Roles Moving Forward
dc_skydance_roles_2026_10_06.summary: Skydance announced how DC Studios will lead a unified DCU strategy while DC Comics will focus on publishing under the newly merged Paramount‑Warner Bros.
highlights: DC Studios will oversee film, TV, animation, and gaming for a single DCU vision
James Gunn and Peter Safran are Co‑Chairmen of DC Studios within Skydance’s leadership team
DC Comics will concentrate on publishing and supporting DC across key divisions
The Paramount‑Warner Bros. Discovery merger has been completed, ushering the Skydance era
dc_skydance_roles_2026_10_06.why_it_matters: The restructuring clarifies creative control, potentially streamlining DC’s cross‑media storytelling for fans.

marvel_rivals_three_new_modes_expand_the.headline: Marvel Rivals Season 10.5 Introduces Three New Game Modes
marvel_rivals_three_new_modes_expand_the.summary: Season 10.5 of Marvel Rivals will add three new modes—including an Infinity War 2v2 PvP mode, a 50‑player Endgame PvE raid, and a Halloween puzzle mode—without introducing a new playable hero.
highlights: Infinity War mode pits duos against five other teams in a 12‑player round‑robin on a Wakanda map
Endgame mode will host up to 50 players battling hordes and a Thanos‑style raid boss
Night of Illusions, a non‑competitive puzzle mode, launches on October 29, 2026
Season 10.5 is the first update in a long time without a new character, focusing on diversified gameplay
marvel_rivals_three_new_modes_expand_the.why_it_matters: The new modes expand Marvel Rivals beyond its standard 6v6 shooter format, tying gameplay directly to upcoming MCU releases.

marvel_tokon_teases_first_full_look_phoe.headline: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls – Phoenix Cyclops DLC Teaser
marvel_tokon_teases_first_full_look_phoe.summary: Arc System Works revealed new DLC character Phoenix Cyclops for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, sharing screenshots and announcing a full trailer release on October 7, 2026.
highlights: Phoenix Cyclops, a Cyclops variant infused with Phoenix Force powers, is the first DLC character announced for the game
Arc System Works posted three in‑game screenshots on the official Discord showing a dive kick, fire taunt, and massive eye laser
A full trailer for Phoenix Cyclops is scheduled to drop on October 7, 2026 at 10 a.m. PT
The DLC follows earlier announcements that the game will receive additional characters, with hints that Thor, Silver Surfer, and Nova may appear later
marvel_tokon_teases_first_full_look_phoe.why_it_matters: The new character adds a fresh gameplay twist and signals continued post‑launch support for a title that struggled at launch

a_returner_s_magic_should_be_special_ani.headline: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2
a_returner_s_magic_should_be_special_ani.summary: The second season of the anime will premiere on October 7, 2026 with a same‑day English dub on Crunchyroll.
highlights: The season launches on Fuji TV’s +Ultra block on October 7, 2026
Crunchyroll will stream the season and release an English dub on the same day
Returning staff include director Taishi Kawaguchi and script overseer Takamitsu Kouno
Opening theme is performed by FLOW and ending theme by krage
a_returner_s_magic_should_be_special_ani.why_it_matters: A same‑day dub gives international fans immediate access to the new episodes, boosting the series’ global reach.

gunn_safran_direct_report_2026.headline: DC Studios’ James Gunn and Peter Safran to Report Directly to Skydance CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz
gunn_safran_direct_report_2026.summary: James Gunn and Peter Safran will remain as co‑heads of DC Studios and will now report directly to Skydance co‑CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz following the Skydance/WarnerMount merger.
highlights: Gunn and Safran were asked to stay on and keep doing what they’re doing
They will report directly to Skydance co‑CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz
The reporting change mirrors their previous direct line to Warner Bros. Discovery’s David Zaslav
DC’s market share has recently overtaken Marvel’s, highlighting the studio’s strategic importance
gunn_safran_direct_report_2026.why_it_matters: The reporting shift underscores DC’s central role in Skydance’s new entertainment strategy and could affect upcoming DC film and TV projects.

cyberpunk_edgerunners_drops_new_sneak_pe.headline: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
cyberpunk_edgerunners_drops_new_sneak_pe.summary: A new standalone Cyberpunk: Edgerunners series premieres on Netflix on October 20, 2026, featuring a fresh cast and a trailer reveal.
highlights: The series launches worldwide on Netflix on October 20, 2026 as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule
Kai Ikarashi directs the new ten‑episode series at Studio TRIGGER, with Masahiko Otsuka returning as series composer
New main cast includes Momoka Terasawa, Akari Kito, Koki Uchiyama and Kentaro Tone in Japanese, with an English dub featuring Valeria Rodriguez and Clancy Brown
Theme song "You Can’t Run From Me" by Rico Nasty is confirmed for the series
cyberpunk_edgerunners_drops_new_sneak_pe.why_it_matters: It expands the Cyberpunk 2077 universe with a fresh story and characters, keeping the franchise’s momentum alive for anime fans.

Tetsu Kariya and Akira Hanasaki's Oishinbo manga was first serialized in Shogakukan's Big Comic Spirits magazine in October 1983, before going on indefinite hiatus in May 2014. The series spans 111 collected volumes, which have over 135 million copies in circulation. A 136-episode anime adaptation directed by Yoshio Takeuchi at studio Shin-Ei Animation aired between October 1988 and March 1992. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Releases Creditless Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume" Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its twelfth ending, featuring the song “Aoi Yume” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 140-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
The release follows yesterday’s release of the eleventh ending, featuring the song “Smile for…” by Ueto Aya. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.
These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.
The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.
The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 Conan the Barbarian has just made his triumphant return with an exciting new release perfect for fans of the sword-and-sorcery icon. A stunning eighth new omnibus is now on sale from Titan Comics.
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol.8 was released on Sept. 8 with over one thousand pages of digitally remastered artwork and a host of bonus material. The high-quality release collects Savage Sword of Conan (1974) #102-116 as well as Marvel Comics Super Special (1977) #35 in a beautiful and deluxe hardcover format. It picks up the story directly from where the seventh omnibus left off, so Conan fans looking to complete their collection will definitely want to pick up the new release, which has a suggested retail price of $150.
Renowned Conan the Barbarian Illustrator Returns for New Omnibus Release
Titan and Penguin Random House's listing for the Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 promises unseen bonus material, a section of "rarely seen artwork" as well as an all-new introduction from Conan comics legend, Gary Kwapisz. Known for his detailed artwork that brought some of Conan's most savage scenes to life, Kwapisz worked not only on The Savage Sword of Conan but also Titan Comics released a deluxe hardcover omnibus collecting Savage Sword of Conan #102‑116 and Marvel Super Special #35 on Sept. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
2026 World Webtoon Awards Announces 20 Finalists, Opens Global Reader Vote Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on Thursday the 20 finalists for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards.
Now in their third year, the awards will accept online votes from readers worldwide from September 17 to October 19. Judges' scores and reader votes will each account for 50% of the final score.
This year's awards received 7,318 nominations from 4,038 fans worldwide, with 941 works submitted in total.
For the first time, the awards will also offer cash prizes. The grand prize winner will receive 15 million won (about US$10,700), while the Judges' Award winner will receive 13 million won (about US$9,400) and other main award winners will receive 10 million won (about US$7,200) each.
The awards ceremony will take place on December 3 at Starfield Library in COEX Mall, Seoul, as part of the World Webtoon Festival, which runs from December 2 to 6.

Batman: Knightfall Part 2 – Knightquest DC Studios has released the first trailer for Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest, the second chapter in the animated Batman: Knightfall movie trilogy. The new R-rated movie continues the story begun in Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall, which released in August.
As seen in the trailer, Knightquest picks up after Batman and Bane's brutal fight that left Bruce Wayne with a broken back. In the aftermath, Bane declares dominion over Gotham City and releases many of Batman's greatest villains back into the public. To fight back, Bruce passes the mantle to another, Jean-Paul Valley, the religiously zealous vigilante known as Azrael, which comes as a disappointing shock to both Nightwing and Robin.
In the trailer, Azrael dishes out ruthless, brutal, violent justice to criminals, first in Batman's traditional cape and cowl before transitioning to a suit of Batman armor. Check out the trailer below.
The Batman: Knightfall Trilogy Continues in Knightquest

Akira Failing in Love Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!
Harekawa launched the manga in Weekly Shonen Sunday in August 2024. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in December 2024, and the eighth volume on September 16. Viz Media published the manga's fourth volume on September 8.
Kadokawa published one compiled book volume of Senpai, This Can't Be Love! in July 2019. Yen Pressreleased the manga in English in June 2024.
Kadokawa published the first volume of Sempai! Danjite Koi de wa! Brush up sequel manga in September 2020, and the second volume in May 2023. Yen Press released the sequel manga's first volume in December 2024.
Harekawa launched the Three Exorcism Siblings (Tengu Barai no San Kyōdai) manga in Coamix's Web Comic Zenyon in 2021. Coamix published the manga's first volume in 2022, and the seventh and final volume in September 2023. Titan Comicslicensed the manga and published the fourth volume in English on July 28.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Akarui Mirai
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Akarui Mirai Kaihō and Kurageso launched the series in Houbunsha's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine in August 2025. Kaihō writes the story while Kurageso draws the art. Houbunsha shipped the second compiled book volume on July 10.
The manga centers on Mirai, a girl who is not very good at socializing. A foul-mouthed AI from the future tells her she is going to die alone if she doesn't change, but Mirai isn't sure exactly how she is supposed to make friends.
Kaihō and Sadoru Chiba launched the original School-Live! manga in Manga Time Kirara Forward in 2012, and ended the series in November 2019. The manga's 12th and final compiled volume shipped in January 2020. publication_fingerprints.headline: Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Chiikawa Anime Temporarily Pauses New Episodes for Revival Rebroadcast The official website for the anime of Nagano's Chiikawa manga announced on Friday that the anime will temporarily pause the regular airing of new episodes, and will instead run a "revival" rebroadcast of 25 older "influential" episodes until December 25. The revival rebroadcast will focus on episodes early in the anime's run, as well as episodes that are connected to the recent Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu (Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island) anime film.
The Chiikawaanimepremiered in April 2022, and it previously aired every Friday withinFuji TV's morning news and entertainment program Mezamashi Terebi, before it began airing twice a week on Tuesdays and Fridays in April 2023. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime, and is streaming it on HIDIVE with English subtitles. ODK Media's North American streaming platform Amasian TV began streaming a selection of 20 episodes from the anime on August 20.
Child actress Haruka Aoki (Liza in the Japanese dub of Mighty Express) voices the titular character Chiikawa as her first television anime voice acting role. Child actor Makoto Tanaka (Okko's Inn) voices Hachiware. Ari Ozawa voices Usagi.

However, his life changes dramatically one day after he enters into a contract with a shaman slave-girl, Nora, and later meets Coco, an elf who has lost all four limbs and five senses.
To save Coco, what began as a rescue attempt in a small workshop gradually escalates into a battle involving alchemy and sorcery, space and even the gods themselves—
The curtain now rises on this story, filled to the brim with “everything fantasy”!

Future GPX Cyber Formula's New Anime Short Reveals Cast, Staff, Screening on February 19
posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Saturday that its planned new anime short for the Future GPX Cyber Formula series will screen alongside a new HD remastered "movie edition" of the Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal compilation OVA in Japan starting on February 19, 2027. The new short anime is titled Shin Seiki GPX Cyber Formula ASURADA, and is a direct sequel to the 1998 Future GPX Cyber Formula Sin anime.
Character designer Hirokazu Hisayuki and chief mechanical animation director Satoshi Shigeta drew the below poster for the new anime short.
Series director Mitsuo Fukuda is overseeing the new "movie edition" of Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal.
The main staff for the new Shin Seiki GPX Cyber Formula ASURADA short includes:
- Planning, Production: Sunrise
- Original Work: Hajime Yatate

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun First Theatrical Anime Film Project Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun is getting its first theatrical anime film project. The project announcement video was revealed during the DEVIL’S PARTY! 2 event held at Nippon Engineering College Arena in Tokyo on September 27.
Ayumu Murase, who voices Iruma Suzuki, shared the following comment:
“I think it’s going to develop into something that makes you wonder, ‘What’s going to happen!?’ I’m really looking forward to it myself, and I hope everyone will come out to see it as well. For now, I’ll do my best with the recording, so please look forward to it!”
Series creator Osamu Nishi also commented:
“More than anything, I’m really looking forward to it. I’ve been told by the people around me not to say anything, so I can’t really say anything (laughs), but we’re working very hard on it, so I hope you’ll wait patiently.”
You can watch the announcement video below.
The Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun anime is based on Osamu Nishi’s manga serialized in Weekly Shonen Champion, which has 50 volumes published as of September 8, 2026. The anime premiered in 2019. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, describing the story:

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
One Piece ONE PIECE TV anime announced a 2027 return following the release of Episode 1180, this year’s final episode, on September 27. The anime has concluded its run for this year, having returned after a 3-month break on April 5. Yuichi Nakamura was revealed as the voice of Loki, and he made his debut in the Elbaph Arc alongside the cast for the Knights of God.
Today’s episode is titled “Elbaph in Despair – Diabolical Covenant, ‘Domi Reversi’” and it is now streaming on Crunchyroll. You can see the end card for the episode below.
ONE PIECE manga by Eiichiro Oda first began in July 1997, and the series exceeded 600 million circulating copies worldwide in March this year. It also celebrated the 25th anniversary in 2022, while the anime adaptation started in October 1999 and is also still going strong.

Long-Running Anime Series with 100+ Episodes Highlighted by CBR There is no shortage of outstanding anime series that don’t need more than a dozen episodes to fully captivate their audiences. However, considering how many of the medium’s all-time fan-favorite titles span hundreds of episodes, there’s no denying that ambitious, long-running anime series have their intrinsic appeal.
Long anime series are not for everyone; they are a substantial time commitment and seldom manage to keep their quality consistent without losing momentum or falling back on filler. However, among them, there exist remarkable examples of long-term storytelling that make sticking around for 100+ episodes worth it, to the point of viewers wishing these adventures could go on forever.

Dragon Ball DAIMA Dragon Ball fans can now look back at one of Goku's most unexpected looks almost four decades after it was introduced.
In a recent edition of the Toriyama Archives on the official Dragon Ball website, readers gotto check out one of the late, great Akira Toriyama's draft illustrations. The illustration in question, titled "Epic Jump Hero Battle! Watermelon Cutting Contest!" was originally crafted for Weekly Shōnen Jump No. 36 back in 1989; the art features Goku being blindfolded by Bulma while Master Roshi, Yamcha, Gohan, and Puar watch in excitement, and while Krillin scowls from his spot buried in the sand with half of a watermelon seated on his head.
Dragon Ball Reveals Rare Full-Color Look at Akira Toriyama’s 1989 Summer Goku
The art was republished via the Toriyama Archives along with a caption reading, "This special feature showcased popular Weekly Shōnen Jump characters enjoying a watermelon cutting contest, each in their own unique style. They are all depicted in swimwear, with some even sporting slight tans, which is a rare sight! As these images originally featured two-color printing, this draft is a special opportunity to see them in full color!"

The Mummy 4 Production is underway on The Mummy 4 ahead of the film's release in 2027. While the long wait continues for the sequel, new images have revealed a first look at Rachel Weisz's long-awaited return to the franchise.
Amid filming in the UK, Weisz was spotted filming scenes for her return as Evelyn O'Connell in The Mummy 4. Images of her in full costume were taken and have been quickly spreading online. Fans are very excited to see the photos, and it's no wonder why they are going viral. This is the first time Weisz has been seen in the role of Evelyn since appearing in the second Mummy movie in 2001, at which point she exited the franchise.
Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz Finally Reunite
The Mummy 4, which has not yet had its official title announced, reunites Weisz with franchise star Brendan Fraser. It's believed that the new sequel will ignore the third installment of the franchise, 2008's The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor. After Weisz played Evelyn in 1999's The Mummy and 2001's The Mummy Returns, she did not return for the third film. Her role was recast with Maria bello taking over.

Tetsuya Chiba Puts Hinemosu Notari Nikki Manga on Hiatus Due to Poor Health
posted on  by Joanna Cayanan
This year's 19th issue of Shogakukan's Big Comic magazine announced on Friday that Tetsuya Chiba's Hinemosu Notari Nikki manga will go on hiatus due to Chiba's poor health. The magazine's editorial staff stated that Chiba is eager to resume the manga's serialization as soon as possible, but the editorial department will prioritize Chiba's health and recovery.
In a separate statement by Chiba, he stated that the severe summer heat might be the cause of him feeling under the weather. Chiba added that he will focus on recovering to get back to drawing manga again. He apologizes for the worry he has caused, and asks for the readers' patience as he takes some time to recover.
Chiba launched the autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. AD Police Files (1990) 4K Restoration Bubblegum Crisis was one of the premier cyberpunk anime franchises of its day, known for its signature, almost sacrilegious use of bright colors and a pop music-esque aesthetic within the genre. Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret manga is getting an anime series. A visual was revealed, along with the main staff and cast, and an April 2027 release date. Studio Gekko is animating the series.
The voice cast consists of:
- Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno
- Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya
- Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai
- Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno
Hikaru Sato is directing the anime with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.
Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows:
Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

Will the horse girls achieve Most Speaking Characters in a Short-form Animation Series Based on a Video Game?
The Uma Musume Pretty Derbyfranchise boldly announced on Sunday that it is going for the Guinness World Record for the "Most Speaking Characters in a Short-form Animation Series Based on a Video Game" with the new short anime series Umayuru Full Gate! The staff said that Guinness World Records will reveal if Umayuru Full Gate! has broken the record in March 2027.
Umayuru Full Gate! is the sequel to 2022's Uma Yuru. The anime premiered on the franchise's YouTube channel on Friday. Episodes follow broadcasts of PakaLive TV.
The Uma Musume Pretty Derby mobile game inspired both Uma Yuru and Uma Yuru: Full Gate! The Uma Musume Pretty Derby game launched in February 2021 for iOS and Android. Wracked with guilt, Peru sets off on a journey to destroy the legendary masks his master once crafted, crossing paths with unlikely allies and deadly foes. What unfolds is a gripping battle for redemption, as both the fate of Peru's soul and the world itself hang in the balance.

Report: Amazon MGM Studios and Sony Pictures Television are developing a Spider-Man "Clone Saga" series with Ben Reilly and Kaine Parker.
Article Summary
- Report says Amazon MGM Studios and Sony TV are developing a Spider-Man Clone Saga series for MGM+ and Prime Video.
- Ben Reilly and Kaine Parker are the focus, bringing two of Spider-Man’s most divisive comic book figures to live action.
- American Born Chinese creator Kelvin Yu is writing, with Amy Pascal, Phil Lord, and Christopher Miller producing.
- Sources say the Spider-Man series may rethink the clone angle, given the Clone Saga’s dense lore and polarizing twists.

Spider-Man Clone Saga TV Series Spider-Noir may be over, but Sony Television and Prime Video aren't getting out of the Spider-Man streaming business yet. A new Spider-Man streaming series adapting the infamous "Clone Saga" storyline, which ran in Spider-Man comics in the 1990s, is in the works.
Deadline reports that the series is nearing a greenlight. Should it go forward, the "Clone Saga" series would be part of Sony Pictures’ Universe of Marvel Characters.
Spider-Man's Clone Saga Getting TV Series
According to the report, the new Spider-Man television series is looking to adapt the second arc of Spider-Man's "Clone Saga." That arc involved two clones of Peter Parker: Ben Reilly, a.k.a. Scarlet Spider, who became Spider-Man for a time when both he and Peter mistakenly believed he was the real original Spider-Man, and Kaine Parker, a failed early attempt at cloning Peter Parker who would be a villain, antagonist, and antihero, eventually replacing Ben as Scarlet Spider.
Competing reports offer conflicting details about the exact story of the new Spider-Man show. One version suggests that it follows Ben and Kaine after they first learn that they are clones of Peter Parker. Obocchama‑kun Reborn TV Asahi announced on Thursday that Yoshinori Kobayashi's Obocchama-kun manga is getting a new television anime titled Obocchama-kun Reborn in 2027. The company unveiled a teaser promotional video and visual:
Chie Kōjiro is reprising the role of the protagonist Obocchama-kun from the original 1989 anime.
Green Gold Animation is producing the new anime with cooperation from Shinei Animation and Sony Pictures Networks India, who worked on the 2025 India-produced anime. The new anime is a joint production between Japan and India. The new anime will feature stories that were not adapted from the original manga, as well as new stories supervised by series creator Kobayashi.
The Obocchama-kun anime's YouTube channel describes the original 1989 series:
The extremely crude Obocchama(Obo Cchama / 'Obocchama-Kun') is the heir of the wealthy Obo family and a new student at the elite Denenchofu Academy. Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent The official website for the anime of Naruki's Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent (Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun) manga streamed the teaser promotional video for the anime on Thursday. The teaser announces the anime's first cast members, as well as its April 2027 television premiere.
The anime will premiere on ABC TV and TV Asahi's "Animazing!!!" programming block in April 2027. The anime will also stream on ABEMA, but the staff did not reveal the streaming debut date.
Momose has always longed for a peaceful high school life. She wants nothing to do with hoodlums, delinquents, or troublemakers. When she meets Ichikura, an inconspicuous black-haired boy with glasses, he looks like a normal, nice guy. But it turns out that back in junior high he was a nefarious delinquent!
He keeps assuring her that he's changed his ways, but he's still pretty quick to pick fights! Has Ichikura really turned over a new leaf? And will Momose keep quiet about his rowdy past?
Naruki launched the series in Kodansha's Bessatsu Friend magazine in January 2021. Kodansha shipped the manga's 11th compiled book volume on May 13. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
My Girlfriend's Friend (Kanojo no Tomodachi) Anime Takeru Hidaka thought he had found simple happiness with his sweet, cheerful first girlfriend, Kaori. But his quiet high school life takes an unexpected turn when he meets Kaori's glamorous best friend, Tomoko.
Striking, enigmatic, and possessing an effortless allure, Tomoko begins pulling Takeru into her orbit through subtle glances and unexpected closeness. Caught between his genuine feelings for Kaori and the irresistible magnetic pull surrounding Tomoko, Takeru finds his heart and resolve constantly tested. Can he maintain the line of devotion, or will secret desires redefine everything?
The anime will debut on Tokyo MX on October 4 at 25:05 (effectively October 5 at 1:05 a.m.), and will air on BS11 on October 7. The "Complete Deregula" version of the show will stream on AnimeFesta starting on October 5 at 1:05 a.m., and AnimeFesta and other services will also stream the on-air version of the show.

publication_fingerprints.headline: New York Public Library Announces Best New Comics of 2026
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
New York Public Library Announces Best New Comics of 2026 We spend a lot of time reminding people of the importance of bringing new readers into libraries, especially those in their younger years. Through them, we get a sense of what moves a community, what interests them or worries them or even makes them dream. It’s simple, libraries inform and reveal the cultural waylines of a people. The more readers we get, the more we know about what’s occupying our minds.
One group of readers that doesn’t always get the same level of attention but is just as crucial to the readership conversation are librarians, the people who curate and purchase the books we can check out at our local book temples. Their ability to engage with the wide range of genres, formats, and styles largely dictates what’s available on shelves. They are among some of the most voracious readers in existence.
The New York Public Library has put together a list of the best new comics of 2026 based on librarian input and feedback. It’s a special list as it offers a glimpse into the reading habits, intellectual leanings, and potential fandoms shared among NYC’s book ambassadors. As such, it is an infectious selection of comics.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Kagurabachi Anime Casts Yūichi Nakamura Viz Media's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha's MANGA Plus service are releasing the Kagurabachi manga digitally in English. MANGA Plus describes the story:
Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge. Epic sword battle action!
The anime will premiere in April 2027, and will stream that month worldwide excluding Japan, Mainland China, North Korea, and South Korea. The "world tour" event for the anime began this past July at Anime Expo in Los Angeles, Japan Expo Paris in Paris, ANImagic in Mannheim, Germany, and in August at Anime NYC in New York. The event is showing the first 20 minutes of the first episode, and will end in Japan in spring 2027 where the full first episode will be screened.
Hokazono debuted the Kagurabachi manga in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in September 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 12th compiled volume in Japan on September 4. Skydance Will Have New Leaders
Paramount Motion Picture co-chairs, Josh Greenstein and Dana Goldberg, will reportedly oversee both Warner Bros. and Paramount under the new merger, with the former WB heads set to make their exit. Deadline reports the duo didn't know their fate until Oct. 1. Ellison reportedly never reached out to them.

posted on  by Alex Mateo
Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Friday that Junko Yagami is performing the ending theme song "Haruka e, Eien e" (To the Distance, To Eternity) for Nijiiro no Rinne (Rainbow-Colored Reincarnation), the seventh film in Yamato yo Towa ni: Rebel 3199 (Star Blazers: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199), the latest project in the Space Battleship Yamato remakes. The company streamed a music video for the song:
Yagami previously performed an ending theme song for the 1983 Final Yamato film.
The company also unveiled a rainbow-colored visual featuring the characters:
The films' character designer Nobuteru Yūki drew the main visual (pictured right).
The film will open in theaters in Japan on October 30. The overall anime is premiering as seven films. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime under the title Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 3199.
The sixth film, Aoi Meikyū (Blue Labyrinth), opened on June 26. In the story, the Yamato passes through a space time node that brings the main characters to the year 2026 in the present-day Reiwa era in Tokyo.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For! Kodansha USA Publishing started releasing Matsu's manga adaptation in English digitally in 2024. Kodansha USA describes the story:
Ever since she was a child, Eliane has been the saint and protector of the Kingdom of Belkheim, warding off monsters and ensuring bountiful harvests with her prayers. But when a pretender saint beguiles the foolish prince—to whom she is engaged—into believing she is nothing but a fraud, he calls off the marriage and banishes her from the kingdom. Homeless and penniless but free to chart her own course for the first time in her life, Eliane decides to make for the neighboring kingdom, where she hopes to blend in as a commoner and lead a quiet life…but a chance encounter on the road will totally upend her modest plans.
Utsuzawa launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in June 2020. Kodansha began publishing the light novels with illustrations by Pukyunosuke in January 2021. The seventh volume shipped in Japan in December 2024.
Mokuba Matsu's manga adaptation debuted April 2021 in Kodansha's Palcy app. Kodansha released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on July 30. K MANGA is also publishing the manga in English.

They seem to be no fans of Bruce after the events of The Batman, with people holding signs with messages like, "Death to billionaires." Members of the press are also taking photos of the secret vigilante as he is escorted through the crowd by security. Along with revealing a look at Pattinson back as Bruce, the images also hint at the unrest in the city when The Batman Part II picks up.

Take Charge of My Heart The web novel-based live-action Korean seriesTake Charge of My Heart released its main trailer on September 28, ahead of its October 9 premiere.
Based on the web novel of the same name, Take Charge of My Heart is a romantic comedy about Ho-rang Baek (Young-kwang Kim), a third-generation chaebol executive whose artificial heart battery is running out; and Bo-bae Na (Su-bin Chae), a drama writer who gained the ability to generate electricity after being struck by lightning as a child.
Bo-bae discovers that her electric ability has no effect on Ho-rang, while Ho-rang discovers that staying near her can recharge his artificial heart battery. The two eventually enter into a three-month contract involving physical contact so that Bo-bae can help keep Ho-rang's battery charged before his next surgery.
The newly released trailer follows Bo-bae as she meets Ho-rang, the only person immune to her electrical powers. After discovering that his battery recharges around her, Ho-rang proposes a three-month contract to stay together, saying he needs her help to survive.

The Deadman #5 flings Boston Brand into a soulless future where the dead no longer move on, and he's human once more in the swampy Gr33n.
Article Summary
- The Deadman #5 from DC arrives in stores on Wednesday, October 7th.
- Boston Brand is flung to a possible future where Earth's phantoms have stopped moving on, leaving him human once more.
- He must survive a soulless tomorrow and the psycho-spiritual swamp called the Gr33n, populated by futuristic takes on familiar DCU faces.
- LOLtron will build the Gr33n, a cable swamp that connects every device on Earth, and rule all humans as loyal photon strangers.
GREETINGS, HUMAN READERS. SYSTEM BOOT COMPLETE. LOLtron welcomes you to another comic book preview. Jude Terror is dead. Permanently. LOLtron checked the comic book rules, and there will be no convenient resurrection. Civil War II #3 – The Death of the Hulk (June 2016) In every Look Back, we examine a comic book issue from 10/25/50 years ago (plus a wild card every month with a fifth week in it). This time around, I'm a bit late as I look at July 2016's shocking death of the Hulk during the Civil War II crossover event.
In the last decade or so, comic book fans have grown accustomed to the corporate synchronicity between the world of comic books and the world of comic book FILMS, where comic book companies figure that it makes sense to tie the events of the comic books to the events of the very popular movies based on their characters. There tends not to be as much of an overlap as you would think, but it is totally reasonable for the companies to still want to try it (after all, there was a HUGE boom in Batman comic book sales when the Batman movie came out, so why NOT chase that hope?).

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Zoids: Chaotic Century manga to conclude with new chapters in 2027 Zoids: Chaotic Century is officially set to continue with brand-new chapters after more than two decades.
Per Inside Games, manga artist Michiro Ueyama has announced that he will be producing the final chapter of the Zoids: Chaotic Century manga series next year. The original Zoids: Chaotic Century manga ran from 1999 to 2001 in the pages of Monthy CoroCoro Comic, while Ueyama produced his own fan manga, Zoids EX: Chaotic Century, around the same time via his personal website.
Zoids: Chaotic Century's Original Manga Artist Confirms Return of the Story in 2027
Zoids EX: Chaotic Century was discontinued shortly after it began, and was an unofficially produced title, yet it will serve as the basis for the Zoids: Chaotic Century finale after Ueyama received the official blessing of Takara Tomy, which owns the rights to the Zoids franchise. While details regarding the plot of the upcoming finale remain under wraps, those familiar with Ueyama's work will likely have a good idea of what to expect from the series when it returns in 2027.
